scope: Close a high-value construction/causality gap: the generated fallback's 30 balcony slabs had rails and facade weathering but no physical terminal drainage or waterproofing interfaces.

commits.message: qa: define balcony drainage waterproofing contract
commits.purpose: Machine-readable manufacture/material/LOD/evidence contract with zero automatic visual points.

commits.message: geometry: add balcony drainage waterproofing assembly
commits.purpose: Generate 30 dry waterproofing/channel assemblies plus 30 manufactured drain grates using dimension-baked chamfered source meshes and only two combined renderers per bay.

commits.message: qa: enforce balcony drainage waterproofing construction
commits.purpose: Fail closed on missing/drifting construction, primitive substitution, material physics drift, floating drains and formal MainCamera evidence.

commits.message: docs: add balcony drainage waterproofing lookdev
commits.purpose: Non-render construction lookdev for rear upstand, threshold turn, channel and drain placement.

researchBasis.observed: Balcony/eave/roof use, sheet-waterproof-compatible drain/strainer construction, nominal 50/65 family and coated strainer behavior.
researchBasis.use: Supports the plausibility of a waterproof-connected balcony drain and nominal 50 mm outlet family; does not prove the benchmark building used this exact product.

researchBasis.observed: Balcony/corridor/landing use and 80 mm minimum channel-bottom width for nominal 50 drainage.
researchBasis.use: Supports the benchmark's conservative 85 mm terminal channel reconstruction; does not establish an exact historical original detail.

implementation.lodPolicy: Retain construction-critical drainage/waterproofing through the Danchi LOD0/1/2/3 renderer-subset transitions; actual temporal absence of pop remains unverified.
implementation.drainPlacement: Alternate left/right by bay parity and preserve vertical alignment by bay.
implementation.geometry: Combined meshes are assembled from QualityBlockSurfaceMeshLibrary dimension-baked chamfered boxes; visible Unity primitive meshes are forbidden.
implementation.weatherState: Dry midsummer. No wet sheen and no disaster/failure state.
implementation.broadFloorFall: Not separately displaced in this change and receives no visual-fidelity credit. Only the terminal drainage interface is implemented.

verification.sourceInspection: PASS: base balcony dimensions, high-detail rail interfaces and absence of drainage/waterproofing were inspected before implementation.
verification.contractSourceQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: exact construction/material/evidence tokens are checked by QualityBlockBalconyDrainageWaterproofingQA.
verification.sceneQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: 30 bays, 60 renderers, canonical mesh/material binding, drain-in-slab bounds, 100 mm benchmark upstand, no colliders and coherent probe/shadow participation are checked.
verification.formalPreCullQA: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_EXECUTED: MainCamera render fails closed if generated-fallback drainage construction is missing or drifted.

knownLimitations: The 100 mm upstand is explicitly a conservative benchmark reconstruction assumption, not an asserted legal minimum or proof of the original building detail.
The broad balcony floor fall is not geometry-displaced by this change and must not receive visual credit.

The two new materials are physically plausible dry dielectric bases but do not yet carry dedicated micro-normal/roughness textures; 4K render review must determine whether that is visibly too uniform.
First-time generated mesh/material asset creation from the save-bound preparation path has not been executed in Unity; compile/serialization behavior is a runner blocker.
The drain grate/channel may still alias or repeat visibly at grazing distance despite geometric manufacturing detail; only temporal/native pixels can clear those risks.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.material_pbr_physical_plausibility: DIRECT_POSITIVE_CANDIDATE: dry membrane and coated grate are constrained to dielectric, non-emissive responses.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.weathering_context_causality: DIRECT_POSITIVE_CANDIDATE: future drainage residue now has a physical terminal source/catchment instead of a bare slab.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.period_accuracy_scene_authenticity: SUPPORTING_CANDIDATE: ordinary balcony service construction improves scene plausibility, but exact historic product identity is not claimed.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporal_lod_aliasing_stability: RISK_ONLY_UNTIL_RENDER: retained through LOD hierarchy, but grate slats and shallow channel edges may shimmer and require pixel evidence.
